apps.name: Framewise
apps.localizedDescription: Fixed frame target with Framed-style gyroscope-guided subject reticle and centered dwell lock, local or optional OpenRouter, Groq, or Gemini vision scans, tap-to-retarget, suggested zoom, high-resolution capture, and optional RAW.
apps.subtitle: Compose the shot you have in mind

versions.localizedDescription: Uses Framed-style point tracking from 32 ms gyroscope samples, direction bands, a 600 ms centered dwell, a latched reticle, and delayed optical zoom. Includes optional OpenRouter, Groq, or Gemini vision scans with local fallback.

Uses Framed-style point tracking from 32 ms gyroscope samples, direction bands, a 600 ms centered dwell, a latched reticle, and delayed optical zoom. Includes optional OpenRouter, Groq, or Gemini vision scans with local fallback.
Keeps the frame target fixed while the subject marker follows the scene, with clearer move cues. Includes optional OpenRouter, Groq, or Gemini vision scans with your own key and local fallback.
Adds optional OpenRouter, Groq, or Gemini vision scans with your own key, secure Keychain storage, and local fallback. Only the reduced scan frame is sent; full-resolution photos stay on device.
Scans one temporary still on-device, guides re-aiming with a motion-anchored target, eases to a recommended zoom, then captures the full-quality photo. No scan upload or per-shot AI service charge.
On-device subject tracking, movement cues, smooth suggested zoom, device-matched optical stops, and optional RAW capture.
On-device object labels, tap-priority subject tracking that survives detector refreshes, movement cues, and smooth suggested zoom.
First-run camera walkthrough, on-device object labels and tracking, tap-to-lock subject selection, move-phone cues, and smooth one-tap continuous zoom suggestions.
Live directional framing tips, tap-to-apply zoom suggestions, and a clearly labeled capture control.
